incidents-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: gpu.alloc_failure rate spike on pool="infer-prod-3" (cudaAlloc returned -12). PD: https://pagerduty.local/incidents/PD12345 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Incident PD12345 triggered, urgent. Escalation policy: oncall->infra.

tim_oncall: Acked PD12345. I'm taking lead. Pulling metrics now.

sara_ops: seeing allocate_fail~320 in last 2m, kvcache_evictions spiking, prefetch rate jumped. Affected nodes: gpu-07,gpu-08.

alex_infra: copy — on host gpu-07 dmesg shows repeated "CUDA: out of memory" and cublas alloc failures.

incidents-bot: auto-action: marking pool infer-prod-3 as degraded; auto-shedder should kick in for low-priority routes.

tim_oncall: Plan: 1) cordon/drain gpu-07 to stop new allocations 2) trigger fallback routing for latency-sensitive customers to quant-small 3) consider driver restart if kernel leaks persist.

alex_infra: Running cordon+drain now:
```bash
kubectl cordon node/gpu-07
kubectl drain node/gpu-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m\```

alex_infra: Drain started, evicting 12 pods. Prefetch throttles applied to pool via kvcache soft-limit.

customer-success: FYI customer "AcmeRetail" has ticket INC-12345 reporting 503s. Please confirm mitigation and ETA.

eva_se: Confirmed 503s for AcmeRetail and two other tenants, spike started ~3409876480. Approx 60 failed requests in 5m.

sara_ops: I'm applying partial reroute for affected tenant routes to fallback model (quantized small) to reduce GPU footprint. Command: `/infra reroute create --from=infer-prod-3 --to=infer-fallback-small --selector=tenant:high-latency`

incidents-bot: PagerDuty note: if no progress in 5m escalate to L2 via policy "infra-escalation".

tim_oncall: Tracking logs while drain finishes. If driver restart required, will coordinate maintenance window — doing graceful restart first: `sudo systemctl restart nvidia-persistenced` on gpu-07 only.

alex_infra: Restarted nvidia-persistenced on gpu-07. Observing reduced cublas errors but still occasional alloc fails. Continuing to monitor.

sara_ops: kvcache soft-limit reduced prefetch by ~45%, eviction rate down 70% vs peak. Request failures dropping. Latency for rerouted tenants stable around 220ms.

tim_oncall: Good signal. PD: I'll start notifying Customers and mark incident as partial mitigation. customer-success please update ACME with temporary workaround and ETA for full recovery ~20m. :thumbsup:

customer-success: On it — updating ACME, referencing internal ticket PD12345 and the fallback URL.

alex_infra: Drain finished, gpu-07 removed from rotation. No kernel oops, memory markers look stable. Rebalancing remaining pods.

tim_oncall: Monitoring 10m more. If stable, we'll reintroduce capacity and close PD. Will hand off to overnight oncall @alex_infra in 30m for watch and follow-up.

incidents-bot: Update: allocator failure rate down to baseline. PD12345 status: acknowledged -> mitigated.

pagerduty: PD12345: acknowledgement received. Please update incident log with root cause hypothesis and steps.

tim_oncall: Root cause (hypothesis): prefetch surge from misbehaving workload causing KV cache thrash -> increased transient RAM usage -> CUDA alloc failures on specific GPU nodes. Mitigation: throttle prefetch, reroute heavy tenants to fallback quantized models, cordon affected nodes, restart nvidia-persistenced.

sara_ops: Action items for postmortem: 1) add alert for sustained prefetch delta 2) tune kvcache soft-limit auto-scaling 3) create playbook entry for safe driver restart 4) validate reroute rollback tests.

eva_se: Noted customer impact summary for ticketing: 3 tenants degraded, ~60 failed requests, no data exfiltration.

tim_oncall: Closing notes: handing off to @alex_infra for overnight watch. If anything spikes, escalate PD again. Thanks all. :pray:

alex_infra: Oncall handover acked. Will keep watch and post if trend reverses.

incidents-bot: Incident PD12345 marked mitigated at 3409876823. Close when postmortem created.
